_meta.captured_against: host-side `mosaic serve --config mosaic.yaml --graphql` on the fixed `../hippo` checkout at commit 3bda128 (unreleased past v0.12.1, includes mosaic#146/PR#147's `relatedTo`) -- NOT the datahelix solo container, which is pinned to the published v0.12.1 image and predates this fix. See mosaic-demo-small/README.md 'Two Mosaic builds in play'.
_meta.data_snapshot: 3600 records (300 donors / 900 samples / 1200 workflows / 1200 datasets), generated by generate.py --seed 0
_meta.known_gotcha: GraphQL filter `field` values must be the LinkML slot name (e.g. `sample_type`, `brain_region`), NOT the GraphQL camelCase field name (`sampleType`, `brainRegion`). Passing the camelCase name silently matches zero rows rather than erroring, not an error. Confirmed empirically against this live endpoint; filed upstream as mosaic#149 (not yet documented or fixed in the schema itself).
_meta.known_gotcha_2: `relatedTo(id, relationshipType)` (mosaic#146/PR#147) answers relationship *existence* for relationships-table-backed multivalued references, but accepts no predicate on the returned entities' own fields -- narrowing by e.g. `workflow_type` requires a bounded client-side filter over that one call's own (small) result, one call per already-identified id. Filed upstream as mosaic#148.

range_filters.note: FilterOp enum has only EQ/IN -- no gt/lt/ne/contains (mosaic#96, open)

sorting.note: no sort argument on the `donors` root query (mosaic#96, open)

samples.mechanism: root-level equality filter on the child type

search.note: searchSamples(q) exists on the schema but no field is annotated hippo_search:fts5 -- always returns []

donor.example: samples { items { donor { id cohort sex historyOfRhi } } }

existence_lookup.note: mosaic#146/PR#147, merged 2026-08-01, unreleased. Returns every Workflow referencing the sample via input_samples, each as a RelatedEntity{entityId, entityType, relationshipType, data} envelope (data.workflow_type is snake_case).

predicate_filtered_lookup.reason: relatedTo accepts no filter/predicate on the returned entities' own fields (e.g. workflow_type) -- confirmed via live introspection of Query.relatedTo's argument list: exactly id, relationshipType, no third argument.
predicate_filtered_lookup.workaround: one relatedTo call per already-identified sample id, then filter that call's own (small, bounded) result client-side by workflow_type -- bounded by the sample's own relationship fan-out, NOT a full-table scan, and therefore an acceptable, documented pattern (distinct from the forbidden fetch-everything-and-match approach)

search.note: searchWorkflows(q) exists on the schema but no field is annotated hippo_search:fts5 -- always returns []

input_samples.example: workflows { items { inputSamples { id donor { id } } } }

datasets_via_produced_by.mechanism: root-level equality filter on the child type

range_filters.note: mosaic#96, open; also file_size_bytes is declared range:float specifically because GraphQL Int is 32-bit and would overflow -- see README

pagination.gotcha: item count in a page can be less than `total` -- always paginate until items retrieved == total before treating a result as complete

as_of_queries.note: graph-level as-of per ADR-0001, present on all four list root queries

provenance_lifecycle.is_available: boolean lifecycle flag on every entity, always populated

mutations.note: not exercised by this read-only benchmark; the eventual NL-GraphQL agent's policy layer must reject all mutations (see design.md's carried-forward Phase 4 scope)
